phase_window_rule: For each reported phase, up to 5 windows of every native row within 0.5 deg of a local maximum of that phase's calculated contribution in the fit's .dia, strongest first; a maximum within 1 deg of a stronger chosen one is skipped, so one phase's windows never overlap. Chosen from the saved fit alone, by the same rule for every answer. A finite selection of calculated peaks: supporting evidence at those positions, not a complete test of the phase; the number of windows says nothing about detection limits or absent phases.

checks.detail: Unexplained residual peaks at or above 2% of the strongest net observed peak: 3.19% at 23.951 deg. 1 more unexplained residual features sit below 2%. Method: residual smoothed over 0.08 deg, local maxima with z >= 5 more than 1 deg from either scan end, unexplained when net observed > 5x net calculated, height as % of the strongest net observed peak; adjacent maxima within 0.1 deg are reported once at the highest. Flag at >= 5%; 2% to 5% is a weak unassigned peak, shown without a flag. Policy kchecks-2026-10-21-p1.
checks.name: Unexplained residual peaks
